chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
“The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbade that the grave be dug deeper than three cubits.”

key_terms.النَّبِيَّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the source of the ruling being transmitted
key_terms.نَهَى: forbade; indicates a prohibition or disapproval in legal context
key_terms.يُعَمَّقَ: to be made deep; to dig deeper

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about how deep a grave should be dug?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding the depth of graves. It indicates that a grave should not be excavated beyond three cubits, reflecting guidance in burial practice within Islamic law.
